# Pediatric Dentistry of Central Florida

> Comprehensive pediatric dental practice serving Maitland and St. Cloud with specialized care for infants, children, and special needs patients.

Pediatric Dentistry of Central Florida is a multi-location dental practice in Central Florida offering a full range of pediatric dental services from infant care through orthodontics. The practice is led by experienced pediatric dentists including Dr. Carlos Bertot, Dr. Kelly Mansour, Dr. David Mansour, Dr. John Tawadrous, and Dr. Marisa Chanin.

## Dental Services

- [Infant Care](https://ibrushteeth.com/sevices/infant-care): Infant care dental services including baby teeth and first dental visit guidance
- [Preventative Care](https://ibrushteeth.com/sevices/preventative-care): Preventative dental care and checkup services for children's oral health
- [Restorative Dentistry](https://ibrushteeth.com/sevices/restorative-dentistry): Restorative services including cavity treatment, fillings, and dental crowns for children
- [Special Needs Dentistry](https://ibrushteeth.com/sevices/special-needs-dentistry): Compassionate dental care for special needs children with dental anxiety support
- [Emergency Care](https://ibrushteeth.com/sevices/emergency-care): Emergency dental care for tooth trauma and dental injuries in children
- [Orthodontics](https://ibrushteeth.com/sevices/orthodontics): Orthodontic services including braces and bite correction for children
- [Sedation Dentistry](https://ibrushteeth.com/sevices/sedation-dentistry): Sedation and anesthesia options for child comfort during dental treatment
- [Lip Tie & Tongue Tie Laser Revision](https://ibrushteeth.com/sevices/lip-tie-tongue-tie-laser-revision): Laser revision for tongue tie and lip tie with infant feeding and breastfeeding support
